translationRepairs: He was appointed assistant in the Minzhong guard office.
He was appointed sheriff of Minzhong.
調閩中尉 is appointment as county sheriff (xianwei) of Minzhong; 尉 is not a guard-office assistant.
He was assigned as assistant in the Minzhong guard office.
He was assigned as sheriff of Minzhong.
The same 閩中尉 is the county sheriff post; the literal “guard office” misreads 尉.
Cao Yanyue, transport commissioner of the Lili circuit, heard of his ability and put him in charge of the grain-purchase stations.
Cao Yanyue, transport commissioner of the Lizhou circuit, heard of his ability and put him in charge of the grain-purchase stations.
利路 abbreviates 利州路 (Lizhou circuit); Lili is not a Song circuit name.
Cao Yanyue, transport commissioner of the Lili circuit, hearing of his worth, had him oversee the grain-purchase stations.
Cao Yanyue, transport commissioner of the Lizhou circuit, hearing of his worth, had him oversee the grain-purchase stations.
The literal likewise misreads 利路 as Lili instead of Lizhou circuit.
Soon he held Hanzhou in temporary authority; by precedent compared with acting officials, stipends and gifts were all as for the real post; Changyi ordered them cut in half.
Soon he held Hanzhou in temporary authority; by precedent, acting officials received stipends and gifts equal to those of regular appointees; Changyi ordered them cut in half.
故事比攝官，奉饋皆如真 means that by precedent acting officials received the same stipends and gifts as regular appointees, not a comparison with a separate class.

He wrapped his bedding with high resolve and set out through the pass. Suddenly he fell ill, and on the road his condition grew grave. When the emperor heard of it, he appointed him Hanlin compiler in the Secretariat Pavilion and transferred him to Jiaxing prefecture.

He wrapped his bedding with high resolve and set out through the pass. Suddenly he fell ill, and on the road his condition grew grave. When the emperor heard of it, he appointed him compiler of the Secret Pavilion and transferred him to Jiaxing prefecture.
授秘閣修撰 is compiler of the Secret Pavilion; 翰林 is not in the Chinese.

With generous spirit he wrapped his bedding and left the pass; suddenly he fell ill; on the road his illness grew severe; the emperor heard of it and appointed him Hanlin compiler in the Secretariat Pavilion, changing him to Jiaxing prefecture.

With generous spirit he wrapped his bedding and left the pass; suddenly he fell ill; on the road his illness grew severe; the emperor heard of it and appointed him compiler of the Secret Pavilion, changing him to Jiaxing prefecture.
The literal invents a Hanlin post; the office named is 秘閣修撰.
His father Yihe had served as investigating censor in charge of the You Shen Observatory.
His father Yihe had served as attendant censor assigned to manage Youshen Abbey.
侍御史 is attendant censor, not investigating censor, and 佑神觀 is the Youshen Daoist abbey sinecure, not an observatory.
His father Yihe was investigating censor in charge of the You Shen Observatory.
His father Yihe was attendant censor assigned to manage Youshen Abbey.
The literal repeats both errors: 侍御史 as investigating censor and 觀 as observatory.

He next served as magistrate of Taiping County and was assigned to handle documents for the Two-Zhe transport office, but before he could take up the latter post he mourned a close relative and was promoted to supervise the Western Treasury of the Left Storehouse at the capital.

He next served as magistrate of Taiping County and was assigned to handle documents for the Two-Zhe transport office, but before he could take up the latter post he went into mourning for his mother and was promoted to supervise the Western Treasury of the Left Storehouse at the capital.
罹內艱 is specifically mourning for one’s mother, not an unspecified close relative.
Wang Gang, styled Zhongju, was a native of Yixian County and the great-grandson of Bo, who had held the post of document signer at the Bureau of Military Affairs.
Wang Gang, styled Zhongju, was a native of Yixian County and the great-grandson of Bo, who had been signatory official of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
簽書樞密院 is the office of signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs, not a clerical document-signer.

He reported illness and asked to retire. He was appointed Hanlin compiler in the Secretariat Pavilion and prefect of Wuzhou, then judicial intendant of Eastern Zhejiang. He declined each post repeatedly but was not permitted to withdraw.

He reported illness and asked to retire. He was appointed Auxiliary Academician of the Palace Library and prefect of Wuzhou, then judicial intendant of Eastern Zhejiang. He declined each post repeatedly but was not permitted to withdraw.
得直秘閣 is Auxiliary Academician of the Palace Library; Hanlin compiler is invented.
If one can jointly admonish inside and outside and unify correction of discipline, if heaven still does not rain, your subject requests to submit to the crime of lying face down in noodles.
If one can jointly admonish inside and outside and unify correction of discipline, if heaven still does not rain, your subject requests to submit to the crime of lying to the throne.
The chapter’s 麵 is a graphic error for 面 in 面謾; Wikisource Songshi 408 reads 臣請伏面謾之罪, so the noodles rendering is false and “lying to the throne” is correct.
Arriving at his post, the year had great invasion; he memorialized remitting nine-tenths of the tax.
Arriving at his post, the year had a great crop failure; he memorialized remitting nine-tenths of the tax.
歲大侵 is a year of severe dearth (侵 for 祲), not a military invasion; s0204’s refugees confirm famine.
In dress and use he did not like luxury; provision accounts and carriage surplus—even if worn he did not replace.
In dress and use he did not like luxury; furnishings and carriages—even if worn he did not replace.
The original “provision accounts and carriage surplus” mistranslates 供帳車剩, but the proposed 車服 is also wrong. Wikisource Songshi 408 reads 供帳車乘: furnishings and carriages.
Earlier, when Mi was at court, Vice Director Ding Huang was sent as envoy to the Jin. Mi sighed and said, "Our hereditary enemy is not yet avenged. How can we act cordially?"
Earlier, when Mi was at court, Vice Director Ding Yu was sent as envoy to the Jin. Mi sighed and said, "Our hereditary enemy is not yet avenged. How can we act cordially?"
丁焴 is Ding Yu; Huang is not the reading of 焴.
Vice Pacification Commissioner along the Yangzi Li Fu recruited him to his staff. When troops in western Huai rebelled, Li sent Ting to summon and instruct them.
Vice Pacification Commissioner along the Yangzi Li Zhi recruited him to his staff. When troops in western Huai rebelled, Li sent Ting to summon and instruct them.
李埴 is Li Zhi; Fu is not the reading of 埴.

When northern troops reached Fuguang, its people fled in panic along the roads. Court opinion held that Ting could hold the place, and he was appointed prefect of Guangzhou while also serving as frontier overall patrol commissioner.

When northern troops reached Fuguang, its people fled in panic along the roads. Court opinion held that Ting could hold the place, and he was appointed prefect of Guang Prefecture while also serving as frontier overall patrol commissioner.
知光州 is prefect of Guang Prefecture (光州), not Guangzhou (廣州).

Braving snow he traveled by night and raced to the prefecture by forced marches. He sent out scouts, put battle equipment in order, fought a great battle at Xieling Bridge, and the people of Guangzhou were secured.

Braving snow he traveled by night and raced to the prefecture by forced marches. He sent out scouts, put battle equipment in order, fought a great battle at Xieling Bridge, and the people of Guang Prefecture were secured.
光人 are the people of 光州, not of Guangzhou.
Ting was summoned to court and soon appointed prefect of Jizhou while still governing Guangzhou.
Ting was summoned to court and soon appointed prefect of Jizhou while still governing Guang Prefecture.
仍知光州 keeps him governing Guang Prefecture, not Guangzhou.
When 200,000 troops from the various routes were about to go recover Chuzhou, Ting led his command as a flanking support.
When 200,000 troops from the various routes were about to go recover Chu Prefecture, Ting led his command as a flanking support.
收復楚州 is recovery of Chu Prefecture (楚州); Chuzhou would render 滁州.

Pacification Commissioners Dong Huai and Deng Yong repeatedly recommended him. He was assigned to Shouchang Command, then transferred to Qizhou, where he built school quarters and erected shrines to loyal ministers.

Pacification Commissioners Dong Huai and Deng Yong jointly recommended him. He was assigned to Shouchang Command, then transferred to Qizhou, where he built school quarters and erected shrines to loyal ministers.
董槐、鄧泳交薦之 is a joint recommendation by both men, not repeated recommendations.
Pacification Commissioners Dong Huai and Deng Yong repeatedly recommended him; he was assigned to Shouchang Command, changed to Qizhou, built school quarters, and set up shrines to loyal ministers.
